lines.t: Make the way straight, make the way straight, make the way straight, make it straight for his return.
The earth trembles, the king is coming.
This is the Lord to the peoples of the earth
In my right hand, the power to birth
In my left hand, judgment and flame
I am he, the ancient of days, the great I am
The God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
Whose name is Israel, none can shake him
I sent my only begotten, the word became flesh
Yahushua, Emmanuel, righteousness and breath
He came once in mercy, he comes again in power
Every knee will bow, every nation will cower The Holy One returns, the trumpet sounds
The Lord of hosts is heaven bound
Make the way straight, prepare His path, don't wait
Yahushua Hamashi, the line will roll Call His name, be restored
Make the way straight, prepare His path, don't wait
Yahushua Hamashi, the line will roll Call His name, be restored
But the Lord comes back
But the Lord comes back
But the Lord comes back
Yeah, ahead came John, the voice in the wild
Crying out repent, the spirit compiled
Trumpet in hand, water and word
Baptized the broken, spoke what he heard
Now 144,000 rise in the land
Fire in their voices, trumpet in hand
Spirit of Elijah, thunder in their breath
Preparing the way to find death
Witnesses walking with tongues of flame
Bearing his name, not seeking fame
Judgments fall, foundations quake
The pride of man, the Lord shall break
Cities fall, towers bend
Desolation sweeps, yet there's hope in the end
Call upon Yahshua, call and be saved
The Lamb who conquered the grave
Yet the sanctuary in the storm
A way of escape has been formed
He is the Christ, I wish you were by name
Call upon Him, be free from shame
Where the Lord comes night
Where the Lord comes night
Make the way straight
Repent and rise great
For the Lord comes night
For the Lord comes night
Let the way speak
Him forever speak
Call upon Him in truth
And you shall surely be delivered
Says the Lord
Yeah, yeah, yeah
Let the Lord come shine
Yeah, yeah, yeah
Echoing in sleep
Woo, woo
In full air of sleep
Woo, woo
And have a good night
